name: Sunset Fumez 1g Live Resin Disposable
description: Sunset Fumez is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the potent Sunset Sherbet X Khyber Mazar Afghan strains. Named for its gorgeous appearance and quick-burning high, Sunset Fumez is the perfect hybrid to add to your daily lineup. This bud has beautifully long and narrow pepper-shaped bright neon green nugs with deep amber undertones, thick reddish-orange hairs and a coating of chunky, amber-tinted white crystal trichomes. As you pull apart each frosty little nugget, aromas of sweet fruity cherries, buttery herbs and sour, citrusy grapefruit are released, intensifying in tanginess the more that you toke.
